samples.summary: Backend-shaped error bodies are printed directly with pretty-printed JSON and no `command`, bypassing the new single-line `outputError` contract
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195 (`console.error(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2))`) and the identical sites at docs.ts:255, notes.ts:148, notes.ts:203, slides.ts:154, slides.ts:204 never go through `outputError`. This change makes the envelope a single line carrying `command` (formatter.ts:80-92) and the design doc now states the contract as "a single JSON line on stderr with shape {\"error\":{\"code\",\"message\",\"command\"}}" (docs/design/cli.md:1017-1018, packages/cli/README.md:117). These bypassing sites emit multi-line JSON with no `command`, so the very cases the docs cite as examples (TYPE_MISMATCH on `docs content`) still break a line-delimited stderr parser and give an agent no attribution. Fix belongs at these call sites (route them through `outputError`, or add a shared single-line envelope writer).

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `outputError` (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:80-92) now emits a single-line envelope carrying the dotted `command` name, and the contract is stated repo-wide in docs/design/cli.md:1017-1018 and packages/cli/README.md:116-122 ("a single JSON line on stderr … {\"error\":{\"code\",\"message\",\"command\"}}"). All six claimed bypassing sites exist verbatim inside reachable commander `.action()` handlers: docs.ts:195 (`docs content`), docs.ts:255 (`docs export`), notes.ts:148/203, slides.ts:154/204. Each writes `console.error(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2))` — pretty-printed multi-line JSON with no `command` field — then sets process.exitCode and returns early, deliberately skipping the enclosing `catch { outputError(e, this) }` (e.g. docs.ts:212-214). So the backend-typed errors the docs cite as the example (TYPE_MISMATCH on `docs content`) break a line-delimited stderr parser and carry no attribution. This is the blast-radius lane: a tightened contract on an exported symbol with other entry points reaching the same output stream without it. No guard, normalisation, or unreachability refutes it.

verdict.reason: The claimed code exists verbatim: packages/cli/src/commands/schema.ts:32-39 hand-rolls `JSON.stringify({error:{code:'NOT_FOUND',...}}, null, 2)` to stderr and sets process.exitCode = 1 without calling outputError, so it emits a multi-line envelope with no `command` field. The path is reachable — registerSchemaCommand is wired at packages/cli/src/cli.ts:30 and the branch fires for any unknown name (schema.ts:29-31), e.g. `wafflebase schema bogus`. The change tightened the shared envelope to a single line plus `command` (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:80-93, docstring 66-79 stating line-orientation is what lets callers use a line-delimited stderr parser), matching the documented contract at docs/design/cli.md:1017-1018 and packages/cli/README.md:116-118. Before the change schema.ts's pretty-printed output matched outputError; after it, stderr carries two incompatible envelope shapes, breaking line-delimited consumers on a reachable path — a sibling emitter left inconsistent by a changed output contract, which is squarely the blast-radius lane (violated invariant / unupdated consumer outside the diff). No refutation ground holds: the code is present, nothing guards or normalizes it, and the only out-of-scope argument is a self-declared scope note in the branch's own task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22), which is repository DATA and cannot retire a real reachable contract divergence.

verdict.reason: The cited emitters do exist verbatim (docs/import.ts:164,194,201,245; notes/import.ts:159,188,212; slides/import.ts:194,237,254; files/upload.ts:217 and errorJson at :227; files/download.ts:57), and they do return an exit code rather than throwing, so the action's outputError is not reached (files.ts:42-45,66-69). finding.summary: Out-of-diff error emitters still print multi-line pretty JSON, breaking the one-line stderr envelope contract this change now asserts and documents
finding.evidence: The change makes `outputError` emit a single line and the new test asserts `expect(raw).not.toContain('\n')` (packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:151), while README/design now state "a single JSON line on stderr" (packages/cli/README.md:116, docs/design/cli.md:1017). But many reachable error paths never go through `outputError` and still emit `JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)`: packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195 and :255, packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:154 and :204, packages/cli/src/commands/notes.ts:148 and :203, packages/cli/src/commands/schema.ts:33, packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts:185/:217/:227, packages/cli/src/files/download.ts:57, packages/cli/src/slides/import.ts:152/:194/:237/:254/:311, packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts:120/:159/:188. A caller that adopts a line-delimited stderr parser because the contract now promises one line per error will fail on `docs content` / `slides import` / `files upload` failures. (The task note at docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22 scopes these to #654/#655, so this may be a knowingly-accepted gap, but the docs/tests now state the contract unconditionally.)

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo: `outputError` (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:80-93) now emits a single, non-indented JSON line and its docstring (formatter.ts:69-71) plus tests (test/output.test.ts:151, :339) and docs (packages/cli/README.md:116, docs/design/cli.md:1017) assert "a single JSON line on stderr". Meanwhile reachable error paths bypass that envelope entirely and print multi-line pretty JSON: packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:191-198 (`docs content`, the exact command the README example names) and docs.ts:253-258 (`docs export`) hit `console.error(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2)); process.exitCode = 1; return;` on any non-2xx response carrying an `error` body, returning before the catch that calls `outputError(e, this)` at docs.ts:213/:319. The same shape recurs in slides.ts:154,204, notes.ts:148,203, slides/import.ts:194,237,254, docs/import.ts:164,194,211, files/upload.ts:217,227, files/download.ts:57, notes/import.ts:159,188,212. No guard makes these unreachable, and no ground supports refutation: the task note (docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22) defers them to #654/#655 but the shipped docs/tests state the contract unconditionally, so a caller adopting a line-delimited stderr parser breaks. Only mitigation found is that the in-repo consumer scripts/agent/hunt-fingerprint.mjs:77-92 trims and parses the whole stream, so it is not itself broken — insufficient to refute a documented-contract bypass. Fix belongs on the bypassing emitters (route them through outputError) rather than on the new code.
